slides.caption: Autumn along the Mississippi
slides.alt: The Mississippi River in Minneapolis stretches across the center of the frame, viewed through bare-branched trees and shrubs with scattered yellow autumn leaves. Calm blue water reflects the clear sky, with low buildings and a bridge-like structure visible on the far bank.

slides.caption: Grain Belt on the Mississippi
slides.alt: The Hennepin Avenue Bridge and the landmark Grain Belt Beer sign on Nicollet Island reflect in the calm Mississippi River in Minneapolis. Bare autumn branches frame the view, with riverside steps in the foreground beneath a clear blue sky.

slides.caption: Cloudy Lake Road
slides.alt: A wet two-lane road runs along a calm lake beneath thick gray clouds, with pale sunlight breaking through near the horizon. A bare tree stands by the shoreline, and part of a vehicle side mirror appears at the lower right.

slides.caption: Quiet Road Through Pines
slides.alt: A straight paved road narrows toward the horizon between dense evergreen trees on the left and bare deciduous trees on the right. Fallen brown leaves line both shoulders beneath a pale overcast sky.

slides.caption: Blue Asters in Sunlight
slides.alt: A dense bed of purple-blue, daisy-like flowers with yellow and reddish centers fills the frame. Green foliage shows between the blossoms, with bright sunlight and small areas of shadow.

slides.caption: Red Jacket Under Trees
slides.alt: Low-angle portrait of a bearded person wearing glasses, a black cap, a bright red jacket, and a dark quilted vest. Green tree branches frame a clear blue sky, with another person partly visible in the background.

slides.caption: Small Ghost on Metal Mesh
slides.alt: A small white ghost-shaped figurine with round eyes and an open mouth sits near the center of a dark, diamond-pattern metal mesh surface. The close black-and-white view emphasizes the rough texture and repeating grid.

slides.caption: Autumn reeds in warm light
slides.alt: A close, full-frame view of dense marsh reeds, with long green blades mixed with orange and rust-colored stems. Warm low sunlight highlights the layered grasses, with no horizon or other landmarks visible.

metadata.lens: iPhone 15 Pro back triple camera 9mm f/2.8

slides.caption: Evening glow on the lake
slides.alt: A calm lake reflects a band of orange sunset beneath a pale blue evening sky. Dark trees frame the view from a deck with a black railing, while two covered boat lifts stand along the shoreline.

metadata.lens: iPhone 15 Pro back triple camera 6.765mm f/1.78

slides.caption: Shared laughter in close-up
slides.alt: High-contrast black-and-white close-up of two adults in hooded outerwear. The person on the left wears dark sunglasses and has a beard, while the person on the right smiles broadly with their mouth open.

slides.caption: Snowfall beneath a basalt tower
slides.alt: Two people in hooded winter jackets smile for a close selfie as snow falls. Behind them rises a tall, columned rock formation dusted with snow against a pale overcast sky.

slides.caption: Seaside wall portrait
slides.alt: A weathered concrete wall covered in graffiti and a large painted portrait of an elderly person stands beside a grassy shoreline. Palm fronds frame choppy ocean water under a bright, cloud-filled sky, with small cake advertisements posted above and below the mural.

metadata.lens: iPhone 15 Pro back triple camera 2.22mm f/2.2

slides.caption: Storm light on the shore
slides.alt: Foamy waves roll onto a wide, wet sandy beach beneath heavy gray clouds. A lone distant figure walks near the waterline as a band of pale pink light opens along the horizon.

metadata.lens: iPhone 15 Pro back triple camera 2.22mm f/2.2

slides.caption: Maple leaves in warm light
slides.alt: An upward view of a maple tree canopy filled with golden yellow, orange, and pink-red autumn leaves against a clear blue sky. Dark branching limbs show through the dense foliage.

metadata.lens: iPhone 15 Pro back triple camera 2.22mm f/2.2

slides.caption: Purple and white lupines
slides.alt: Tall purple and white lupines rise through green grass, with small orange wildflowers scattered in the foreground. The background foliage and distant blooms are softly blurred in warm daylight.

metadata.lens: iPhone 15 Pro back triple camera 6.765mm f/1.78

slides.caption: Cyclist into the mist
slides.alt: A cyclist in a bright yellow jacket rides away on a paved path bordered by tall green grass. A quiet road, utility poles, and dense trees fade into pale fog ahead.

slides.caption: Moonlight on the water
slides.alt: A bright moon hangs above calm water, casting a narrow silver reflection toward a dark, rocky shoreline. Evergreen and bare trees form a black silhouette at left beneath clouds and a deep blue night sky.
